German University Preparatory Programme (GAPP)

GMI describes this as a preparatory pathway for study at a University of Applied Sciences in Germany. It includes preparation at GMI and German language training.

Check the official page for the current structure, intake and application route.

GMI-UTP Foundation Programme (GUFP)

Foundation in Engineering and Science, offered through the GMI and Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS partnership. GMI describes it as a one-year foundation programme.

Check the official page for the current structure, intake and application route.

Diploma entry requirements

For engineering and engineering technology diplomas, GMI’s 2025 programme guide gives an SPM route: at least three credits including Mathematics, one Science/Technical/Vocational subject and one other subject, plus a pass in English.

Other qualifications and programme-specific requirements exist. This screen does not decide eligibility. Open the current GMI diploma admissions page and its entry requirement document to confirm the course you want.

GAPP entry requirements

Sponsored candidate (YTP MARA): GMI lists SPM grade A in English, Additional Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and four other subjects.

Private candidate: GMI lists SPM/IGCSE/O-Level or equivalent grade C in English, Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.

Confirm the current criteria and sponsorship conditions on the official GMI page before applying.

GUFP entry requirements

SPM route: minimum grade C in Bahasa Melayu, Mathematics, English, Additional Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.

O-Level/IGCSE route: GMI lists at least five credits (grade C or 60% and above), including Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Additional Mathematics and one other subject.

Confirm the current criteria on the official GMI page before applying.

German-Malaysian Institute (GMI) was established in 1991 through cooperation between Malaysia and Germany. It offers diploma and pre-university programmes as well as technical training.
